title: The Quran Has One Picture of a Caved-In Building. It Uses It Three Times, for Three Different Reasons.
excerpt: The exact phrase khawiyatun 'ala 'urushiha — a place "fallen in upon its own roofs" — appears in exactly three Quran verses, and each time it backs a different lesson: a question about resurrection (2:259), the ruin of misplaced trust in wealth (18:42), and the fall of a wrongdoing nation (22:45). One collapse-image, spent three ways.
seo_title: "Fallen in Upon Its Roofs": The Phrase in Quran 2:259, 18:42, 22:45
seo_description: The phrase khawiyatun 'ala 'urushiha ("fallen in upon its roofs") appears in exactly three Quran verses, each carrying a different lesson: resurrection (2:259), misplaced trust (18:42), and the fall of the unjust (22:45). A corpus-verified reading — the word khawiya alone appears five times.
